name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-styled-super-mario-bros-2-enemies-pack
title: Super Mario World Styled Super Mario Bros. 2 Enemies - Pack 1
description:
Custom graphics for the Super Mario Bros 2 enemies from Romi's Sprite Tool 1.41 and/or Mikeyk's updated sprite pack. This pack contains graphics for:

-Shy Guy
-Snifit
-Tweeter
-Beezo
-Phanto
-Birdo (both normal & boss/updated version)
-Bob-Omb
-Spiny
-Mushroom Block & Veggies

Do note that Twetter, Phanto and Birdo are meant to use palettes B, A and E/F respectively (depends on whenever you're using the game's original Sprite Palette 1 or 7), so you might wanna tweak their properties with a .cfg editor first.

Credit's optional, just don't claim it as your own.

Moderator's Notes : Do remember that if you've changed the tilemap of your shy-guys or other sprites, do remember to edit this file accordingly, otherwise good job, they fit SMW's style nicely.
